line: Forgive a small grudge and let it go today.
paragraph: The oldest man in Oregon turned 108 this week. Three large blue balloons shaped the number above him. A cake sat nearby. He said he had discovered something: you do not know what it is like to be past one hundred until you get there. He has gotten there, and he likes it. He credits a clean diet and a good mind for the miles.
